Key Benefits Scale-up transaction volume and drive growth Strengthen client satisfaction and loyalty Monitor credit risk exposure Improve liquidity and trade relations for your clients Gain competitive advantage What is supply chain finance? Supply chain finance is a win-win scenario where the supplier gets paid early from a third-party provider whilst the buyer maintains their original payment timeline. It’s designed to optimise the flow of capital between buyers and suppliers in a supply chain to reduce costs, improve cash flow, and enhance financial efficiency for everyone involved. There are different forms of supply chain finance, including: Trade credit – buyers receive longer payment terms while suppliers get paid sooner. Invoice financing – suppliers get immediate cash by selling their invoices to a financier. Reverse factoring – suppliers get early payment from a bank or financier with the buyer paying at a later date. Supply chain finance works when a supplier provides goods or services to a buyer, and an invoice is sent to the buyer for payment. The supplier, buyer, or both engage a financial institution to arrange early payment or extended payment terms. The financial institution pays the supplier early or managers the payment terms with the buyer repaying the institution at a later date. ICC API pilot for Trade Finance guarantees Surecomp > About us > News > BNP Paribas, Vanderlande and Surecomp drive successful completion of Swift – ICC API pilot for Trade Finance guarantees Toronto, 14 November 2024 – Surecomp today announced that, together with BNP Paribas and Vanderlande, it has successfully piloted a new corporate-to-bank connectivity standard designed by Swift and the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC). The Application Programming Interface (API)-based communication channel enabled Dutch logistics company Vanderlande – a leader in future-proof logistic process automation for the warehousing, airports and parcel sectors – to request a guarantee through Surecomp’s RIVO™ platform, which was transmitted securely to BNP Paribas in real-time without manual intervention. Aimed at facilitating the automation of corporate-to-bank trade finance exchange, the initiative – which leverages an XML formatted open-API message – is easy and cost effective to implement. It also improves data integrity, promotes greater agility and is particularly well suited to corporates with limited transaction volumes. “This is the beginning of a new and very promising journey in the digitalization of bank guarantees,” comments Marie-Laurence Faure, Head of Digital Trade Channels at BNP Paribas. “It is a significant industry milestone, and we invite all other trade finance stakeholders to join this initiative for the benefit of the entire ecosystem.” “I’m very pleased we worked with Surecomp and BNP Paribas on testing this API for guarantees,” says Eddy Veenstra, Customer Finance Director at Vanderlande. “Taking a collaborative and standardized approach with our trade finance partners is proving hugely valuable in helping us gain better control and visibility of our guarantees and expedite trade to enable more robust future growth.” “API-first solutions are the key enabler to lowering thresholds to digital trade transformation,” states Enno-Burghard Weitzel, Surecomp’s Chief Solutions Officer. “Our role as an industry leader is to help shape the future of digital trade hence the importance of being an early adopter of new standards like this one. By using our RIVO™ platform as a centralized hub, banks, insurance companies and corporates can connect in real-time and now leverage the Swift – ICC API to execute faster, more efficient guarantees, which will ultimately improve cash flow and drive trade growth.” Please click here for more information about BNP Paribas Please click here for more information about Vanderlande Follow us on LinkedIn Keep in touch Please fill in the form if you would like to be added to our mailing list to receive Surecomp updates!
